changes.note: Regional is the only lender in the corpus whose sheet carries a full consumer rate grid, and none of it was in the app. 112 cells: 4 model-year bands x 4 front-end LTV bands x 7 tiers. Every cell was read twice -- once from a 300 dpi render of each half of the table, once from the text layer -- and the two agree in document order, all 112. New/current-year and 2024-2025 are listed as separate bands and price identically.

ambiguities.note: This grid is the TX sheet's consumer rate, i.e. the rate to the customer, not a buy rate the dealer marks up. The reserve section already holds the flat/discount participation schedule that sits alongside it. Both come off the same page.
